properties.name: awsParameterStorePropertySource.enabled
properties.description: Explicitly disables the Kubernetes external secret property source.

properties.name: awsParameterStorePropertySource.enabledProfiles
properties.description: Comma-separated list of Spring profiles for which the property source should be enabled. If not specified, the property source will be enabled for all profiles.

properties.name: awsParameterStorePropertySource.haltBoot
properties.description: Whether to halt the application boot if the property source fails to load. If false, the application will continue to boot even if the property source fails to load.

properties.name: awsParameterStoreSource.ssmClient.endpointConfiguration.endpoint
properties.description: The endpoint to which the SSM client should connect. If not specified, the client will connect to the default AWS endpoint for the configured region.

properties.name: awsParameterStoreSource.ssmClient.endpointConfiguration.signingRegion
properties.description: The AWS region to use for signing requests to the SSM endpoint. If not specified, the client will use the default region configured for the application.

properties.name: awsParameterStoreSource.multiRegion.ssmClient.regions
properties.description: Comma-separated list of AWS regions to use for multi-region support. If specified, the property source will attempt to load properties from SSM in each of the specified regions.

properties.name: awsParameterStoreSource.ssmClient.maxErrorRetry
properties.description: The maximum number of retry attempts for failed requests to the SSM endpoint. If not specified, the client will use the default retry policy.
